channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Warning · Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier
item.description: Flood Warning issued October 10 at 9:53PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA. In effect until further notice. Areas: Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, Orange. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.

item.title: Coastal Flood Advisory · Aransas Islands, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands, Calhoun Islands, Coastal Aransas, Coastal Kleberg and 4 more
item.description: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 11 at 12:54AM CDT until October 13 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX. In effect until Oct 13, 1:00 AM CT. Areas: Aransas Islands, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands, Calhoun Islands, Coastal Aransas, Coastal Kleberg, Coastal Nueces, Coastal San Patricio, Coastal Refugio, Coastal Calhoun. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.

item.title: Coastal Flood Advisory · Kenedy Island, Willacy Island, Cameron Island
item.description: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 10 at 6:58PM CDT until October 12 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Brownsville TX. In effect until Oct 12, 7:00 AM CT. Areas: Kenedy Island, Willacy Island, Cameron Island. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
